dormfix.title: Extract receipt text before model parsing
dormfix.change: Replaced direct receipt-image input to the local model with Tesseract text extraction followed by Ollama parsing.
dormfix.reason: Give text extraction and structured payment-field parsing separate responsibilities.
dormfix.outcome: The model receives OCR text with a Zod-defined response format. OCR and the local model both remain operational dependencies.

dormfix.title: Move receipt and maintenance parsing to Gemini
dormfix.change: Replaced the local Ollama client and response format with Gemini calls and provider response schemas for payment and maintenance analysis.
dormfix.reason: Keep structured analysis while changing where model inference runs.
dormfix.outcome: At this revision, receipt extraction still uses Tesseract. Parsing now needs a Gemini API key and access to the hosted service; the local pipeline in this case study represents the earlier design.

dormfix.title: Prepare PostgreSQL storage and deployment configuration
dormfix.change: Migrated SQL Server data access to PostgreSQL, added Supabase schema files, and introduced Render deployment configuration and database integration tests.
dormfix.reason: Adapt the existing workflows and transaction handling to the new database and hosting configuration.
dormfix.outcome: Repositories now use PostgreSQL queries and a shared transaction helper. The migration adds schema and deployment work alongside the database change; this commit does not establish a successful release.

isdalog.title: Connect delivery completion with a payout
isdalog.change: Added a delivery-completion method that locks a listing, credits the harvester wallet, and completes listing and logistics records inside a database transaction.
isdalog.reason: Coordinate the delivery state and its associated wallet update.
isdalog.outcome: This earlier design couples completion with payout. Later revisions make the cargo handoff and buyer-confirmed financial step distinct.

isdalog.title: Introduce separate pickup and delivery codes
isdalog.change: Added pickup and delivery verification fields and dispatch methods that check the appropriate code at each handoff.
isdalog.reason: Represent the port pickup and buyer delivery as separate custody transitions.
isdalog.outcome: Pickup moves the order into transit; delivery records the destination handoff. Invalid codes return an error instead of completing the corresponding transition.

isdalog.title: Extend buyer confirmation with payouts and reviews
isdalog.change: Refactored buyer confirmation to credit harvester and rider wallets, record reviews, clear the held balance, and complete the order in a locked-order transaction.
isdalog.reason: Group the financial and review records around the buyer's confirmation action.
isdalog.outcome: The method checks buyer ownership and rejects already-completed orders. The delivery handoff remains a separate dispatch operation.

centralog.title: Add interchangeable valuation strategies
centralog.change: Introduced straight-line and double-declining strategy classes, with an enum selecting the algorithm.
centralog.reason: Give each valuation formula its own implementation using asset and maintenance inputs.
centralog.outcome: Both strategies subtract recorded repair time and apply a salvage-value floor. The maintenance adjustment is an explicit application policy.

centralog.title: Calculate depreciation at calendar-day boundaries
centralog.change: Normalized evaluation, asset start, and maintenance timestamps to dates, replacing fractional elapsed days with whole calendar days.
centralog.reason: Avoid second-by-second changes in the displayed valuation for unchanged records.
centralog.outcome: Calculations use day-level precision, trading sub-day changes for a consistent calendar-day result.

centralog.title: Separate procurement totals from depreciated value
centralog.change: Changed the inventory dashboard total to sum recorded procurement costs, replacing its sum of calculated depreciated values, and added a unit test.
centralog.reason: Give the inventory summary a total based on recorded purchase values while keeping time-dependent valuation in the financial ledger.
centralog.outcome: The dashboard total depends on procurement records rather than elapsed depreciation time. The two totals answer different reporting questions.

pharmalink.title: Align checkout receipts with the sale response
pharmalink.change: Updated checkout to read the returned sale ID and construct receipt details from the cart. Product searches gained a 500-millisecond debounce.
pharmalink.reason: Connect the receipt to the API response and reduce product lookups while staff type.
pharmalink.outcome: The client builds the receipt after sale creation returns and clears the cart. Its receipt date and total come from client data at this revision.

pharmalink.title: Represent corrections and voids as adjustments
pharmalink.change: Replaced the client's delete-style void call with adjustment requests and added original/effective values, revisions, reasons, and request identifiers to the sale contracts.
pharmalink.reason: Represent a sale change alongside the original record and provide a way to look up a submitted adjustment.
pharmalink.outcome: The client can describe a correction or void and query it by request key. These contracts alone do not establish backend stock or transaction guarantees.

pharmalink.title: Export paginated sales with consistency checks
pharmalink.change: Added a collector that traverses sale pages and rejects observable changes in counts, page metadata, or record IDs. CSV output includes original and current sale values.
pharmalink.reason: Avoid silently exporting repeated or missing records while preserving adjustment history in the report.
pharmalink.outcome: Detected inconsistencies stop the export for a deliberate retry. Offset pagination still does not provide a database snapshot.
